restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Puttery asks guests to notify servers of food allergies or dietary restrictions and says to ask about gluten-friendly options; no allergen-free kitchen or cross-contact guarantee is stated.

notes: Current orderable catalog is reconciled to the official Washington DC menu; section headings and the typo duplicate are excluded while frozen-key reconciliation and supported direct ingredient allergen evidence are preserved. Official allergen matrix remains accurately unavailable.

proposedChanges.catalogRepair: Rebuilt the current orderable catalog from official DC HTML/PDF menu rows; removed extracted headings, navigation, policy text, location fragments, and composite parser artifacts; collapsed the typo duplicate spinach-articoke-dip into spinach-artichoke-dip.
